name: quadriceps lying stretch
description: A stretch for the front of the thigh done lying on your side or front. It loosens tight quads after leg work.
instructions: Lie on your side with your legs stacked and your head resting on one arm.
Bend the top knee and grab that ankle with your top hand.
Pull your heel toward your glutes while keeping your knees close together.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.
